findings.title: FND-01 zombie-pending recurrence: 06-14 status-flip for DIRECTIVE-20260603-003 + -20260607-002 never landed in git
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md (Pre-flight: Operator Directive Discovery lifecycle bullet) asserts these two directives were 'both flipped by tinker-2026-06-14T07-54 only after re-verifying the work was OBE.' Yet a fresh origin/main clone on 2026-06-18 still showed both as status:pending. Either the 2026-06-14 run wrote the flip to FUSE (the exact bug it was documenting) instead of the clone, or its push omitted the directive files, or a later revert undid it. Net effect: both directives re-preempted the dispatcher every run for 4+ days. This run re-flipped them correctly via clone-and-push. RECOMMENDATION: add a post-push verification step to the lifecycle-flip procedure (re-read origin/main after push to confirm status landed), and/or have a future run audit whether the 2026-06-14T07-54 push actually included operator-directives/*.json.
